mapper.insert: INSERT INTO policy (policy_no, holder_name, product_type, premium, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{policyNo}, #{holderName}, #{productType}, #{premium}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, policy_no, holder_name, product_type, premium, status, created_at, updated_at FROM policy ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE policy SET holder_name = #{holderName}, product_type = #{productType}, premium = #{premium}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
